blocks.content: Someone will change something in the console. Terraform notices on the next refresh and proposes to undo it, which is correct but occasionally alarming.

terraform plan -refresh-only    # what drifted?
terraform state list            # what do we track?

items: Adopt an existing resource with an import block rather than recreating it
Rename or restructure with a moved block, so no destroy is planned
Never hand-edit the state file; use the state subcommands

blocks.title: Read every destroy
blocks.content: A rename without a moved block reads as destroy-then-create. On a database that is the difference between a no-op and an outage.
